name: Alphalete - Page Sheet
body:
> Tracker · Alphalete · 2026-10-01

# Summary
The Page Sheet is a published artifact listing every live URL on alphaletetrenchless.com with its SEO tags, Google index status and search traffic. The local folder holds its HTML source (`page-sheet.html`, last saved Oct 1 2026) plus 7 backups taken before refreshes. The page loads its data at runtime, so the local HTML is a shell (spreadsheet-style grid with light and dark modes and a formula bar for reading full cell text).

# How it is used
- It is the change record for the safe edit loop: every live edit is noted in the Page Sheet.
- **Refresh procedure** (from the project guide): wp-cli inventory, curl of each live head, GSC UI Performance > Pages (US) and URL Inspection, then republish the artifact to the same URL.
- Artifact URL is listed in the project guide and the Oct 1 handoff.
- The Sep 29 check (Page Sheet v24) recorded 108 of 111 tracked URLs indexed.

# Related tracker
The weekly change tracker (scheduled task `alphalete-weekly-change-tracker`, Mondays about 8am) writes GSC snapshots to a separate artifact. It needs the app open and Chrome connected.
